fusions.name: Bounding Bite
fusions.desc: Throws a snapping jaw that deals 8 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Clatter Run
fusions.desc: Looses 3 small jaws at once, each dealing 4 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Burrow Litter
fusions.desc: Conjures a litter of small jaws onto the nearest enemy. They wait 30 seconds, and the first 4 enemies to come within 1.5 tiles take 7 damage in a blast around it. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hopscotch Teeth
fusions.desc: When you cover a long stretch of ground, a jaw snaps shut on the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
